### The Moment of Judgment and Salvation
Author: Tabletalk Magazine
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/moment-judgment-and-salvation
Passage: John 12:31-32
Points:
- Jesus explained that His impending death marked a decisive judgment upon the fallen world.
- By crucifying the Son of God, humanity revealed its willful love for darkness over light.
- The cross served as the battleground where Satan, the ruler of this world, was defeated.
- Christ's resurrection proved that the devil and death possessed no ultimate power over Him.
- In being lifted up, Jesus draws people of every culture and background to Himself for salvation.

### Lift Him Up and Watch What Happens
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-10-2026.html
Passage: John 12:32
Points:
- The apostolic church grew and flourished because it preached a Christ-centered message.
- A local congregation cannot remain vibrant unless it consistently exalts the Lord Jesus.
- True Christian worship magnifies Jesus Christ in every service and gathering.
- Believers and leaders must examine their ministries to ensure Christ remains at the center.
